responsibility: This file implements libgccjit’s internal tracing facility. It defines the logger class that writes version-prefixed, indented, line-buffer-flushed log messages and scope-entry/scope-exit traces, plus the log_user ownership helper that reference-counts shared loggers across contexts and other JIT objects. Its responsibility is runtime logging behavior and logger lifetime management, not JIT IR construction or compilation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-logging.h, which declares the logger, log_user, log_scope, and logging macros, this same-stem .c file implements the logging behavior itself: version-prefixed output, indentation and scope tracing, flushing, and logger reference-count lifetime management.
